privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: How your personal data is collected, used and protected on the Wafia website.
privacy.lede: How Wafia Agency processes the data submitted through wafia.fr.

blocks.text: Only the data needed to process your request:

items: Links to your social media profiles (applications)

blocks.text: Your data is used to respond to your contact or quote request and to review your application (pre-contractual measures, Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR), and to ensure the security of the site (legitimate interest, Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

Contact data is kept for 3 years from the last exchange, and applications for 2 years. The data is intended for the teams of Wafia Agency and its subcontractors: OVH (hosting), Sentry (technical error monitoring) and Upstash (form protection). Some of them may be located outside the European Union, under the European Commission’s standard contractual clauses.

Under Articles 15 to 22 of the GDPR, you have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection, as well as the right to withdraw your consent at any time. To exercise them, write to us at contact@wafia.fr.
You may lodge a complaint with the CNIL (the French data protection authority), 3 place de Fontenoy, TSA 80715, 75334 Paris Cedex 07.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.description: Information about the cookies used on the Wafia website and how to manage them.
cookies.lede: The cookies set on wafia.fr and how to manage them.

blocks.text: A text file placed on your device when you visit the site, used to remember certain information for a limited period.
No advertising cookies or social network pixels are set on wafia.fr.

items: Sentry — technical error detection, session duration.
Google Analytics — audience measurement, loaded only after your consent.

blocks.text: You can refuse or delete cookies at any time in your browser settings (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge), or follow the CNIL guide.
